systems.system: National Civil Registration System (NCRS)/National Identity Card
systems.country_label: National Civil Registration System (NCRS); National Identity Card
systems.tiers: National; listed as Sierra Leone's foundational ID system and credential, with no digital ID for online transactions; 43 per cent of adults report owning the ID (Findex fieldwork 3 October to 9 November 2024), below the 2021-2022 estimate

note: A global dataset on adult ID ownership; the system is named in a table of foundational ID credentials with no description of how civil events are recorded, and Sierra Leone's birth registration is not separately reported.
